response.goal: We get partnership requests by email. We want each new email in our "Partners" Gmail label summarized by an AI model and added to Airtable: sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary and a priority flag. A person on our team reviews anything marked low confidence.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirements review for Gmail and Airtable schema alignment.
Develop the script to read new emails from the "Partners" Gmail label.
Integrate AI summarization to extract sender, company, request type, summary, and priority flag.
Configure Airtable integration to store parsed leads and route low-confidence items for review.

milestones.name: Phase 1: Gmail Integration & AI Parsing
milestones.deliverable: Working script connecting to Gmail and processing emails with an AI model.

milestones.name: Phase 2: Airtable Sync & Review Workflow
milestones.deliverable: Data successfully writing to Airtable with low-confidence routing.

proof_map.step: Kickoff and requirements review for Gmail and Airtable schema alignment.

risks.risk: Budget is specified as an hourly range without a fixed project cap.
risks.mitigation: Establish a weekly hour cap and clear milestone check-ins to control costs.

risks.risk: Client job post mentions OpenAI API while proof project uses Gemini API.
risks.mitigation: Confirm preferred AI model during kickoff and adapt the Python script accordingly.

questions: Do you prefer OpenAI or another LLM provider for the summarization?
What specific fields are currently set up in your Airtable base for the partnership requests?
assumptions: The client has an active Airtable account and Gmail account with API access permissions ready.
The hourly rate agreed upon will fit the estimated hours required for development and testing.
